_comment: TODO(#356 follow-on): generate this from astrolift_manifest source-of-truth on the backend (e.g. a `make manifest-schema` task that dumps the dataclasses + per-field doc strings). Hand-curated placeholder content lives below.

sections.title: [meta]
sections.summary: Static identification: app slug, manifest version, owner team. Read once at registration; not used at runtime.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier, unique within the project.

sections.title: [deploy]
sections.summary: Deployment topology — target cluster, replica count, rollout strategy, resource requests/limits.

fields.name: cluster
fields.description: Tenant cluster slug; defaults to the project's default cluster binding.

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: Rollout strategy — rolling | recreate. Default: rolling.

sections.title: [env]
sections.summary: Per-environment overrides (dev / staging / prod). Each environment gets its own [env.<name>] subsection with merged settings.

sections.title: [[workloads]]
sections.summary: Containers, ports, healthchecks, command/args. Repeating section — multiple workloads per app are allowed.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Workload identifier, unique within the app.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Container image reference (registry + tag or digest).

fields.name: ports
fields.description: Container ports exposed to the cluster network.

sections.title: [[managed_services]]
sections.summary: Provider-managed dependencies (Postgres, Redis, object storage, etc). Each binding is provisioned and its connection details injected into the workload env.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Service kind — postgres | redis | object_storage | kafka | …

fields.name: binding
fields.description: Env-var prefix used when injecting connection settings.

sections.title: [ingress]
sections.summary: Public exposure — hostnames, paths, TLS, the IngressDriver routes traffic via the cluster's ingress class.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Custom hostname. Wildcard certs from the managed domain are reused when available.

sections.title: [ci]
sections.summary: Continuous integration knobs — source provider, branch filters, build commands, preview-env policy.

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Default branch tracked for production deploys.

sections.title: [domain]
sections.summary: DNS records to reconcile via the DnsDriver. Tied to a ManagedDomain on the org so wildcard certs and zone delegation are reused.
